name: Eureka
description:
Spotlight-style search bar and app launcher for GNOME 50, like macOS Spotlight, Alfred or Raycast. Press Super+Space and type: apps, open windows, files and folders, emoji, Settings pages, calculator, unit and currency converter, lock/suspend/restart and web search, all in one box.

Material You look that follows your accent colour, light or dark, with optional blur. Customise the theme, colour, shape, size, font, transparency, shortcuts, sources and web engines.

Private and safe: nothing logged, no network unless you turn on the currency converter (it only downloads the ECB's public rates, never your searches), and it never runs programs or scripts it finds. It uses its own window and does not modify the overview, so it cannot break GNOME's own search.

Clipboard: Eureka never reads the clipboard. It writes to it only when you press Enter on a calculator or converter result, or Alt+Enter to copy a file path.
